properties.notes: The site gained prior approval for 40 units in September 2018 (18/02398/GPDOFF). Following this full planning permision was granted in Feburary 2019 (18/03684/FUL). Previously the site had prior approval (17/01714/GPDOFF) and full planning permission (17/03275/FUL) for 37 units. As of 1 April 2020 all units were recorded as started on site. The site is deliverable within five years.
